_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary head term for the sr homepage; safe in titles/H1/meta as-is, ekavica spelling.
phrases.good_example: Lepi Fontovi i Stilizovana Slova za Kopiranje

phrases.usage_guidance: Category-page head term; already the sr/podebljana-slova/ page title and H1.
phrases.good_example: Generator Podebljanih Slova — 𝐩𝐨𝐝𝐞𝐛𝐥𝐣𝐚𝐧𝐚 𝐬𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐚 za kopiranje

phrases.usage_guidance: Standard, unambiguous typographic term — safe as page title/H1.
Both the full form (gotička slova, title/H1) and the short colloquial form (gotica, used throughout FAQ prose) are natural — use full form in titles, short form in body copy.
phrases.good_example: Generator Gotičkih Slova — 𝔤𝔬𝔱𝔦𝔠𝔞 za kopiranje

phrases.usage_guidance: Page title/H1 term as shipped; 'kapitalke' alone is the natural short form used elsewhere in FAQ prose (e.g. describing TikTok-friendly styles).
phrases.good_example: Generator Malih Slova — ᴍᴀʟᴀ sʟᴏᴠᴀ i kapitalke za kopiranje

phrases.usage_guidance: 'Zalgo' itself is not translated (matches global internet usage); pairs with the Serbian descriptive gloss 'ukleti, glitchani stil' (cursed, glitchy style) for readers unfamiliar with the term.
phrases.good_example: Zalgo je onakav „ukleti", glitchani stil — nad i pod svakim slovom naleti gomila dijakritičkih znakova.

phrases.usage_guidance: The dominant, unmarked Serbian term for 'nickname' across the whole sr/ site and confirmed as the natural term forum users themselves use to discuss why they chose their online identity.
phrases.good_example: Može li se napraviti nadimak za igru ili za Discord?

phrases.usage_guidance: Use specifically for the restrictive login/@ field (a–z, 0–9, dot, underscore only) as distinct from the more permissive display-name/nadimak field — this distinction is the whole point of the Discord field-mapping guide.
phrases.good_example: Zašto Discord kaže da je moje korisničko ime nevažeće?
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use interchangeably with 'nadimak' when the content is specifically about the restrictive login-field vs. permissive display-field distinction — conflating them is exactly the confusion the Discord guide exists to resolve.

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary CTA phrasing; site currently uses the imperative short form 'Kopiraj' as the button label and spells out 'Klikneš „Kopiraj", nalepiš u...' in instructional copy — matches how the leading Serbian-localized competitor brands its own tool.
phrases.good_example: Klikneš „Kopiraj", nalepiš u instagram bio, nadimak u igri, WhatsApp status ili opis na TikToku.

phrases.usage_guidance: 'Ukrasi' (decorations, plural noun) is the site's own umbrella label for the frames/dividers/symbols layer; 'ukrasna slova' is the more description-oriented phrase used by outside sources for the same concept.

phrases.english_concept: diacritic hook (on č ć š ž)
phrases.usage_guidance: The natural Serbian word for explaining how the generator handles č/ć/š/ž — use it instead of a clinical term like 'dijakritički znak' when writing for a general audience; the site already models this well.
phrases.good_example: generator sad rastavlja č, ć, š, ž na osnovno slovo i kvačicu, stilizuje slovo i vraća kvačicu na njega

phrases.usage_guidance: Exact natural phrasing for the 'why do my styled letters look broken to other people' complaint — already the FAQ question wording on-site.
phrases.good_example: Zašto se nekome prikazuju kvadratići umesto slova?

phrases.usage_guidance: Exact wording of Discord's own rejection behavior and the site's guide title — precise 'invalid/rejected characters' concept-family term.
phrases.good_example: Zašto Discord kaže da je moje korisničko ime nevažeće?

phrases.usage_guidance: Key differentiator/trust phrase for the Discord-fonts page title — answers the implicit 'do I need to pay' question up front.
phrases.good_example: Fontovi za Discord: Slova za Nadimak i Bio (Bez Nitra)

phrases.usage_guidance: Correctly platform-specific: the site uses 'bio' for Instagram and 'opis' for TikTok, matching how each platform actually labels the field in its own Serbian-language UI — do not use 'bio' generically for both.
phrases.good_example: Rade li slova u opisima na TikToku?

phrases.usage_guidance: Common trust-signal phrasing across the site's meta description and FAQ opener — reinforces the free/no-signup value prop consistently.
phrases.good_example: Da, sve je 100% besplatno. Bez naloga, bez dnevnog ograničenja, bez vodenih žigova, bez kvake.

phrases.usage_guidance: Precise, already-shipped phrasing for the 'Instagram cut my styled characters' complaint — distinguishes the restrictive @username field from the permissive 'Ime'/bio fields, mirroring the Discord username-vs-nickname distinction (SR-009).
phrases.good_example: Instagram mi je izrezao deo znakova u nadimku — šta sad?
